blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Buena Park
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Knott's has its own parking lot, but Beach Boulevard and the I-5 ramps around it are the real bottleneck on event nights.

Scary Farm and Merry Farm nights produce a late egress crush on I-5 and SR 57, where a driver is genuinely valuable.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Buena Park Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.
